comparison.event_time_gate: Run the .001 s control over the complete event window, record native dt statistics, bracket threshold crossings, and verify snapshot quantization plus integration differences within the frozen budget before promoting event timing.
comparison.promotion: Compare native integration, half-native integration, and the .001 s event-output control; do not call a downsampled trajectory an integration study.
comparison.reference_matrix_role: The .01 s complete-window matrix is a raw macro-observable reference; it carries no event-time qualification claim.
